summary.method: Extraction: exact production worker bundle (worker/src/index.ts @ 4ffb053) with stubbed fetch over curl-fetched page HTML (2026-09-24). Render: exact production renderer bundle (src/renderer.ts) on node-canvas with real Poppins/Mulish fonts, replicating App.tsx postDataFromWorker image-loading incl. /img proxy fallback. fillText instrumented for overflow detection; drawImage instrumented for zero-size detection. Zero code changed.
caveats: Engagement icons render as plain gradient rects in this harness (node-canvas lacks Path2D); browser rendering unaffected.
Fonts are real Poppins/Mulish TTFs from Google Fonts; line-wrap should match production closely.
126499 linkCard image (frontpagemag.com URL) 404s at the source (link rot); tool gracefully renders the card without the preview image, as designed.
